comment: Provenance ledger for the simulation. A = direct measurement or primary mission data; B = analogue, ground experiment or operational practice; C = simplified game rule. Each record states what it supports and where the game stops being real.

research.topic: Moon facts: gravity, synodic month, day length
research.useEn: Surface gravity 1.62 m/s²; synodic month 29.53059 Earth days; 30-day mission mapped onto lunar days.
research.useAr: جاذبية السطح 1.62 م/ث²؛ الشهر القمري 29.53059 يومًا أرضيًا؛ المهمة 30 يومًا موزعة على أيام قمرية.
research.boundaryEn: The game compresses time; the real month passes at real speed.

research.topic: Illumination map of the Moon's south pole and Shackleton rim
research.useEn: Rim sites receive long, grazing illumination; permanently shadowed regions nearby stay dark and cold.
research.useAr: مواقع الحافة تتلقى إضاءة طويلة مائلة؛ المناطق المظلمة دائمًا قريبة وتبقى باردة ومظلمة.
research.boundaryEn: The selected site in the game is fictional but bounded by real polar illumination geometry.

research.useEn: Two-hour lighting steps south of 88°S; basis for the slow seasonal solar curve in the clock.
research.useAr: خطوات إضاءة كل ساعتين جنوب 88°؛ أساس منحنى الطاقة الشمسية الموسمي البطيء في الساعة.
research.boundaryEn: The game samples this into a smooth 30-day curve, not a terrain shadow model.

research.topic: Chang'e-4 LND lunar surface absorbed dose
research.useEn: 13.2 ± 1 µGy/h in silicon at the surface; the baseline dose rate in the colony model.
research.useAr: 13.2 ± 1 ميكروغراي/ساعة في السيليكون على السطح؛ معدل الجرعة الأساسي في نموذج المستعمرة.
research.boundaryEn: This is absorbed dose in silicon, not a human dose equivalent; the game labels its dose model as simplified.

research.useEn: Machine-readable dose-rate and flux records by body, trajectory, spacecraft and instrument.
research.useAr: سجلات معدل الجرعة والتدفق قابلة للقراءة آليًا حسب الجسم والمسار والمركبة والجهاز.
research.boundaryEn: Live values are not streamed into the game; the model uses published reference levels.

research.topic: NASA DONKI solar energetic particle events
research.useEn: SEP alerts and event timelines; basis for the day-12 solar particle event and shelter protocol.
research.useAr: تنبيهات الجسيمات الشمسية والجداول الزمنية؛ أساس حدث اليوم 12 وبروتوكول الاحتماء.
research.boundaryEn: The day-12 event is authored for the mission, not a real 2026 event.

research.useEn: Water ice is documented in polar permanently shadowed regions, unevenly distributed; sample verification comes before resource claims.
research.useAr: جليد الماء موثق في مناطق قطبية مظلمة دائمًا وموزع بشكل غير متساوٍ؛ التحقق من العينة يسبق ادعاء المورد.
research.boundaryEn: Ice is not proven at the game's exact site; Alaa's storyline is written as a prospecting hypothesis.

research.topic: Lunar regolith hazards to equipment and crews
research.useEn: Abrasive dust clings to suits, seals, optics and radiators; dust accumulation drives array and sensor maintenance.
research.useAr: الغبار الكاشط يلتصق بالبدلات والأختام والبصريات والمشعات؛ تراكمه يقود صيانة الألواح والحساسات.
research.boundaryEn: Accumulation rates and cleaning effectiveness are game-tuned, not measured.

research.topic: ISS water recovery and crew hygiene
research.useEn: Up to 93% water recovery on ISS; the colony recycler uses 93% as an ISS-class reference.
research.useAr: استعادة ماء حتى 93% في محطة الفضاء الدولية؛ يستخدم نموذج المستعمرة 93% كمرجع.
research.boundaryEn: 93% is an ISS figure, not a guaranteed lunar-base performance value.

research.topic: CSA Interplanetary Farming crop planning values
research.useEn: Lettuce 21–28 days, soybean 45–65, tomato 50–90, carrot 70–80, chickpea 80–100, sweet potato 90–170, wheat 213–244.
research.useAr: خس 21–28 يومًا، صويا 45–65، طماطم 50–90، جزر 70–80، حمص 80–100، بطاطا حلوة 90–170، قمح 213–244.
research.boundaryEn: Planning values from an educational resource, not lunar-field yields.

research.topic: NASA Veggie, XROOTS and closed-chamber plant growth
research.useEn: Enclosed plant chambers with controlled light and nutrient delivery; the greenhouse is sealed and lit by colony power.
research.useAr: غرف نبات مغلقة بإضاءة وتغذية مضبوطة؛ الدفيئة مغلقة وتضاء بطاقة المستعمرة.
research.boundaryEn: Orbital and ground experiments; they do not prove the same yields on the Moon.

research.useEn: Noor's method: read the sensor, check flow, then change the filter, never the other way round.
research.useAr: طريقة نور: اقرأ الحساس، افحص التدفق، ثم غيّر المرشح، وليس العكس.
research.boundaryEn: Apollo 13 happened in a spacecraft during flight, not at a lunar base.

research.topic: Apollo 17 field geology and sample documentation
research.useEn: Site coordinates, repeat measurement and chain of custody before interpreting a sample.
research.useAr: إحداثيات الموقع وتكرار القياس وسلسلة الحيازة قبل تفسير العينة.
research.boundaryEn: Inspiration for method, not evidence of ice extraction in a shadowed crater.

research.topic: NASA 3D-Printed Habitat Challenge and ISRU construction
research.useEn: Regolith processing, shielding and printed structural test pieces; Mostafa's workshop loop.
research.useAr: معالجة الثرى والتدريع وقطع اختبار إنشائية مطبوعة؛ حلقة عمل مصطفى.
research.boundaryEn: Printed habitats are a research concept, not an operating lunar facility.

research.topic: How NASA protects astronauts from space radiation at the Moon
research.useEn: Regolith shielding, shelter protocols and dose tracking; the storm shelter and dose log.
research.useAr: التدريع بالثرى وبروتوكولات الاحتماء وتتبع الجرعة؛ ملجأ العاصفة وسجل الجرعة.
research.boundaryEn: Shelter effectiveness is simplified to a 75% dose reduction in the game.

research.useEn: Some polar PSRs reach about −203 °C; the ice site and thermal model use deep-cold boundaries.
research.useAr: بعض المناطق القطبية المظلمة تصل إلى نحو −203 °س؛ موقع الجليد والنموذج الحراري يستخدمان حدود البرد العميق.
research.boundaryEn: The game's habitat sits on an illuminated rim, not inside a PSR.

research.useEn: 1,900–3,200 kcal per person per day; the model uses 2,800 as a mid-range planning value.
research.useAr: 1900–3200 سعرة للفرد يوميًا؛ يستخدم النموذج 2800 كقيمة تخطيط متوسطة.
research.boundaryEn: An ISS reference range, not a universal lunar diet.
